text.tspan: Share of population living on less than the lower-middle income poverty
The lower-middle income poverty line is $3.20 per day in 2011 prices and $3.65 per day in 2017 prices. This data is
adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Share of population below $3.65 a day
Share of population below $3.20 a day

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2024)
Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Following an

text.tspan: update, World Bank PIP now uses 2021 international-$ for its poverty and inequality data available here.
